data.body:
Operator decision (2026-08-20): CLOSING as a DUPLICATE of `shady-blueblack-whale` (559b-b7cd-6552-437d),
which is claimed and actively under investigation.

WHY DUPLICATE RATHER THAN NOT-A-BUG. The RCA on this ticket originally recommended closing it as
not-a-bug for the rebar repo, on the grounds that the fault lives in the host-local
`~/.local/bin/rebar-dev-update.sh` rather than in rebar. That reasoning was sound in isolation but
incomplete: `shady-blueblack-whale` reports the SAME MECHANISM under a different trigger —
`uv tool install --force` garbage-collecting the release directory backing a live process, versus
this ticket's hourly-updater `prune_releases()` doing the same thing. Both surface as an
`ImportError` naming a module that demonstrably exists in the source tree. One defect class, two
triggers, so one ticket should own it.

WHAT WAS PROVEN HERE, now transplanted onto that ticket as a comment so nothing is lost:
  * The published runtime is an EDITABLE install — the release venv's site-packages holds only
    `_editable_impl_nava_rebar.pth` pointing at `<release>/src`, with no copied package. That is WHY
    deleting the release directory mid-process is fatal rather than untidy.
  * rebar imports `commit_impact` LAZILY at `_commands/close_precheck.py:283`, inside
    `_check_file_impact_vs_diff`, which runs late in a close AFTER the minutes-long
    completion-verifier gate — a long window in which the race is reachable.
  * Reproduced character-for-character offline: import the parent, `rmtree` the tree, trigger the
    lazy import. Negative control with the tree intact imports fine.
  * Four alternatives rejected with evidence: file present at that commit (`git ls-tree`), wheel
    CONTAINS it (`uv build --wheel`), nothing gitignored or hatch-excluded, and the then-current
    global runtime imported it fine.
  * The headline claim on this ticket — "breaks every close with file_impact from a packaged build"
    — is FALSE. The failure requires the delete-during-run race.

ALSO RECORDED THERE: the reported "exits 0" is an artifact of the invocation shape, not a swallowed
exception. An uncaught ImportError through `rebar.cli.main()` exits 1 correctly; the reporter's
command was `rebar transition … 2>&1 | tail -20`, and a pipeline's status is its last stage's.

The two tickets are linked `relates_to`. No code change was made under this ticket and none is
needed here — any durable fix belongs either to the install/lifetime layer that
`shady-blueblack-whale` is tracing, or to the host-local updater script, which is outside this
repository.
